notes.title: Season 3 — Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[p]📢 [b]Season 3 is on the horizon![/b][/p][p]Every new season in our game brings fresh items, and now it’s time to introduce [b]Appol stocks[/b] 🍏📱.[/p][p]✨ Unique items from Season 3 will join the collection.
🔥 They’ll only be available for a limited time, and once the season ends, they’ll be almost impossible to obtain.
⭐ Don’t miss the chance to be among the first to own these [b]Appol stocks[/b]![/p][p]⚠️ With the arrival of the new season, [b]AMxD stocks[/b] will stop dropping completely. This is your last chance to add them to your collection![/p][p]⏳ Stay tuned — the exact launch date of Season 3 will be announced soon.[/p]

notes.title: Creator Event
notes.notes: [p]We are launching a [b]Creator Event[/b] and inviting all players to participate![/p][p]📌 [b]How it works:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Create a post or video about our game (review, guide, reaction, meme — any format works).[/p][/*][*][p]Publish it on any platform: YouTube, TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, Discord, forums, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Send the link to your publication in our [b]Discord[/b] in any text channel or message the developer directly![/p][/*][*][p]Receive in-game rewards![/p][/*][/list][p]🏆 [b]Reward system:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Every post/video = guaranteed reward.[/p][/*][*][p]The more views and reach your content gets — the better the prizes (special items, bonus drops, unique seasonal stocks).[/p][/*][*][p]Top creators will receive [b]exclusive rewards[/b] and a special mention in our community![/p][/*][/list][p]🔥 Share your creativity, grow your collection, and help the game expand together with us![/p]

notes.title: We are published!
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 [b]Stocks is officially released on Steam![/b]
🚀 A collector simulator where drops come just for being online!
✨ Jump in right now — the [b]first season[/b] is live, and you can grab unique items that won’t drop as often later!
🔥 First season items are the most valuable! Don’t miss out![/p][p]💬 Join our Discord and leave your honest feedback about the game — it really helps us improve! ❤️[/p]
